Anker opens Japanese Eufy E35 preorders and C30 Edge sales

Both robot vacuums use onboard cyclonic dust separation and automatic mop care; E35 general sales are scheduled for November 17.

PR TIMES / Anker Japan ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 28Videos 1

Two Japanese market launches

Anker Japan opened Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni E35 preorders on November 5, with general sales scheduled for November 17 at ¥199,900 including tax. C30 Edge sales began November 5 at ¥129,900. Both use onboard cyclonic dust separation to reduce filter clogging. No Thai price is announced in this release.

Different cleaning hardware

E35 offers up to 35,000 Pa suction, a continuously washed roller mop extending 32 mm, and AI.See 3.0 recognition of over 280 object types with LED illumination. C30 Edge has the same stated peak suction, dual rotating mops extending 7.6 cm and a station approximately 31.5 cm tall.

Laboratory claims have limits

The manufacturer claims up to 365 days of sustained high suction under test conditions. E35’s reported removal of over 99% of certain microbes refers to wiping or mop-washing tests. These results do not cover every bacterium or virus, and performance varies with the home and operating mode; they are not universal real-world outcomes.
